calibration_note: Calibrated using a checkerboard pattern. Parameters follow the OpenCV camera model convention.

image_resolution.note: 4K UHD. Verify against your specific footage if resolution differs.

camera_matrix.description: Intrinsic matrix K = [[fx, 0, cx], [0, fy, cy], [0, 0, 1]]. Units: pixels.

distortion_coefficients.description: OpenCV distortion model: [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3]. k1/k2/k3 = radial distortion, p1/p2 = tangential distortion.
distortion_coefficients.distortion_note: k1 = 0.26 indicates significant barrel distortion. Undistortion is important for accurate metric measurements, especially near frame edges. DVM applies this correction internally before computing geo-projected coordinates.
